operations.content: hermes mcp add prompts Enable-all-tools Y/n and cancels without TTY input; piping printf Y-newline into it completes non-interactive adds, and hermes mcp list plus hermes mcp test NAME verify the result.

Hermes MCP stdio subprocesses inherit a filtered env, so keys like TAVILY_API_KEY_* must be passed explicitly via --env; server paths with spaces need quoting and first-time npx servers need a longer --connect-timeout (120s worked for server-filesystem).

Opencode reads Tavily, Cloudflare, and Supabase keys from shell env (TAVILY_API_KEY_1..5, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN), not from config files; its Tavily key-rotator launcher lives at F:/CD/Opencode/.opencode/tools/tavily-rotator/launcher.mjs with state in .opencode/tavily-state.json.
